package main

import "strings"

// messagesPrivmsg handles PRIVMSG. Unknown commands and the not-registered
// rule are handled by running.go's dispatch, so only registered clients get here.
func messagesPrivmsg(s *Server, c *Client, m Message) {
	if len(m.Params) < 2 || m.Params[1] == "" {
		s.Reply(c, "412", "No text to send")
		return
	}
	target, text := m.Params[0], m.Params[1]
	key := strings.ToLower(target)

	if strings.HasPrefix(target, "#") {
		ch := s.channels[key]
		if ch == nil {
			c.Send(":" + serverName + " 401 " + c.Nick + " " + target + " :No such nick/channel")
			return
		}
		if !c.channels[key] {
			c.Send(":" + serverName + " 404 " + c.Nick + " " + target + " :Cannot send to channel")
			return
		}
		line := ":" + c.Prefix() + " PRIVMSG " + ch.name + " :" + text
		for _, mem := range ch.members {
			if mem != c {
				mem.Send(line)
			}
		}
		return
	}

	dst := s.clients[key]
	if dst == nil || !dst.Registered {
		c.Send(":" + serverName + " 401 " + c.Nick + " " + target + " :No such nick/channel")
		return
	}
	if dst == c {
		return
	}
	dst.Send(":" + c.Prefix() + " PRIVMSG " + dst.Nick + " :" + text)
}

func messagesInitBody() {
	handlers["PRIVMSG"] = messagesPrivmsg
}
